description: Add cross-module pipeline polish and engagement prediction features for launch readiness. This includes: (1) Add a Schedule pipeline button to post_generator.py alongside existing Copy/Optimize/Hook/Visual/Save buttons, (2) Add a lightweight deterministic engagement prediction score after post generation, (3) Add a 'Copy Plain Text' button that strips Unicode formatting, (4) Expand core/examples.py with hook-specific examples that other modules can use for quality calibration.
steps: Step 1: Expand core/examples.py -- Add a new list _HOOK_EXAMPLES with 6-8 standalone hook lines extracted/inspired from the existing full post examples (first lines). Add a get_hook_examples(n=3, seed=None) function that works identically to get_examples() but returns hook-only strings. Also add a _COMMENT_EXAMPLES list with 3-4 short (2-4 sentence) example comments that demonstrate the quality expected, and a get_comment_examples(n=2, seed=None) function.

Step 2: In post_generator.py, add a 6th pipeline button '📅 Schedule' after the existing 5 buttons (Copy, Optimize, Hook, Visual, Save). Change the columns from 5 to 6. On click, set st.session_state['scheduler_pipe_content'] = post_content and st.session_state['_pending_nav'] = '📅 Content Scheduler', then st.rerun(). This connects the Post Generator output directly to the Content Scheduler module.

Step 3: In post_generator.py, add a 'Copy Plain Text' button that uses the existing _strip_fmt() function to produce clean text. Replace the current '📋 Copy' button behavior (which reveals a code box with raw text) to first strip Unicode formatting via _strip_fmt(post_content), then show it in a st.code() box. This ensures LinkedIn-ready plain text without formatting artifacts.

Step 4: Add a lightweight engagement prediction score to post_generator.py. After the post is generated and displayed (after the Voice Validator badge), add a deterministic scoring function _predict_engagement(post: str) -> dict that returns a score 0-100 and brief reasons. Scoring factors: hook length and specificity (does it have numbers/names?), post length (sweet spot 200-500 words), paragraph variety (not all same length), presence of human signatures (dialogue, numbers, time anchors), absence of banned phrases. Display as an expandable section with st.expander('📊 Predicted Engagement Score'). This is NOT an AI call -- it's a fast local calculation.

Step 5: Update the tests to cover the new functions in core/examples.py. In tests/test_voice.py (or a new tests/test_examples.py), add tests for: get_hook_examples returns the right count, get_comment_examples returns the right count, both handle n > available gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: core/examples.py exports get_hook_examples() and get_comment_examples() alongside existing get_examples()
post_generator.py has 6 pipeline buttons including Schedule
The Copy button strips Unicode formatting before showing the code box
A deterministic engagement prediction score (0-100) appears after post generation without making an AI call
New tests for get_hook_examples and get_comment_examples pass
verification: export PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 && python -c "from core.examples import get_examples, get_hook_examples, get_comment_examples; print(len(get_hook_examples(3))); print(len(get_comment_examples(2)))"
